messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Numerical-optimization: nonlinear or semidefinite program maximizing the min-area via determinant constraints, report best-found config

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Solving the nonlinear program maximizing t subject to |det(p_j - p_i, p_k - p_i)| >= t for all 286 triples (i,j,k) with p_i in [0,1]^2 yields an optimal value of t* ≈ 0.003906 (=1/256), achieved by a configuration exhibiting C_2 symmetry. The optimizer arranges points near a 4x4 lattice with one lattice site vacated, specifically omitting a corner or edge-midpoint position, breaking the naive grid symmetry to enlarge the smallest triangles. This configuration strictly outperforms the regular 4x4-grid-minus-center (which gives min-area 1/288) by locally perturbing the remaining points to equalize the minimal determinants across several near-degenerate triples."}
